subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open conflicting fork candidate for the Feishu reply-mention fix, or ask that author to rebase it before any new target-repository repair is queued?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the linked same-repository PR is closed unmerged and the open fork candidate is conflicting, cannot be maintained by this repo, and carries prior routing/security concerns.

options.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the existing candidate as context but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the open fork PR author to rebase and address the previous safety concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug without starting a new repair lane until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate as context but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent Feishu-area and mention-handling history among the routing candidates.
